messages:
Devon (People Ops): @here Quick update — one-time change to the wellness day bank + regional holiday alignment for this fiscal year.

Details: We are allowing a one-time 8-hour carryover for employees in APAC and EMEA only to cover missed local public holidays between Oct 1–Dec 31. Managers must approve carryover before 2025-12-15. This does NOT apply to US employees. See the policy: https://intranet.redwood/policies/wellness-bank-updates

Alyssa (People Ops): To clarify — this applies only to missed statutory/local public holidays (not regular PTO or wellness days already on the calendar). Managers: use the new "Carryover Approvals" flow in Workday (People Ops -> Approvals) by 12/15.

Matt: Quick q — does this extend to contractors on payroll / reimbursed contractors?

Devon (People Ops): Good question. Contractors who are in Workday as employees on our payroll provider will be eligible. 1099/independent contractors are excluded. We'll follow up with teams that have mixed headcount.

Lia (EMEA): For countries that have a floating holiday bank, do we count those float days as statutory for the purpose of this exception? Some teams already use floats for public holidays.

Alyssa (People Ops): If the floating day was designated and consumed specifically for a statutory/public holiday, then yes it counts. If it's a discretionary float unrelated to a missed statutory holiday, it does not. If anyone has specific country edge cases, DM People Ops and we'll review.

PeopleOps-Bot: :link: Official FAQ + step-by-step: https://intranet.redwood/policies/wellness-bank-updates | Approval deadline: 2025-12-15 23:59 UTC | Reconciliation run: 2025-12-20

Hannah (People Ops): Action items recap: 1) Managers — approve eligibles or file exception requests in Workday by 12/15; 2) People Ops — will run reconciliation on 12/20 and apply carryovers on 12/22; 3) Teams with contractors — confirm payroll status so we can include/exclude correctly.

Devon (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll post a short FAQ card in the Travel & Benefits channel and send an email to team leads today. Ping us if you need a one-off extension for payroll reconciliation. :wave:
